datasets.name: RVL-CDIP / Tobacco3482 Document Image & Text Corpus
datasets.official_source: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~aharley/rvl-cdip/ and UCSF Truth Tobacco Industry Documents Archive
datasets.license: Public Domain / Open Access for Research and Educational Use
datasets.permitted_use: Document classification, layout analysis, optical character recognition research, academic benchmarking
datasets.description: Scanned real-world business and official administrative documents across categories including forms, letters, memos, reports, and invoices.
datasets.limitations: Does not contain genuine-vs-forged ground-truth labels. Cannot be used to train fraud or authenticity classifiers.
datasets.preservation: Original OCR extracted text, category labels, and document identifiers are preserved.

datasets.name: FUNSD: Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents
datasets.license: Open Academic & Research Use License (Guillaume Jaume et al.)
datasets.permitted_use: Key-value pair extraction, form entity recognition, layout semantic linking
datasets.description: Comprises 199 fully annotated scanned real forms containing 31,485 word-level bounding boxes and semantic entities (header, question, answer, other).
datasets.limitations: Contains genuine historical forms only; does not contain counterfeit or forged document instances.
datasets.preservation: Original semantic key-value relationships and entity categories are preserved.

datasets.name: SROIE: Scanned Receipts OCR and Information Extraction
datasets.official_source: ICDAR 2019 Robust Reading Competition on Scanned Receipts
datasets.permitted_use: Text localization, OCR benchmarking, key entity extraction (company, date, address, total)
datasets.description: Contains 1,000 real scanned receipts with word-level OCR coordinates and key information ground-truth.
datasets.limitations: Receipt-focused; does not contain government security features or fraud indicators.
datasets.preservation: Original entity annotations and text coordinates are preserved.

datasets.name: Public Official & Academic Credentials Reference Corpus
datasets.official_source: Authorized public domain institutional degree formats, Open Government Data (data.gov.in / national portals), and verified public notices
datasets.license: Public Domain / Open Government Data (OGD) / Educational Reference
datasets.permitted_use: Format benchmarking, schema validation testing, and consistency review research
datasets.description: Real text templates and anonymized official credential formats for university degrees, state certificates, and identity documents.
datasets.limitations: Anonymized to protect personal identifiable information (PII) per privacy standards.
datasets.preservation: Original legal syntax, institutional attestation structures, and chronological headers are preserved.

authenticity_disclaimer: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DISTINCTION: As documented by scientific literature and problem statement SIH1709, OCR datasets and document classification datasets do not provide ground-truth fraud or forgery labels. Document consistency, chronological integrity, and missing information are evaluated via the Explainable Production Rule Engine. Document category recognition is evaluated via Supervised Machine Learning. True legal authenticity requires cryptographic signatures or authoritative issuer API verification.
